h2: NDT consulting for Houston companies: program, audit and procedure work, and how Houston's providers differ

NDT consulting for Houston companies: program, audit and procedure work, and how Houston's providers differ

Most Houston requests for NDT consulting come from one of five places: an inspection contractor trying to get onto, or stay on, a Ship Channel operator's approved-vendor list; a fabrication shop with a code job that needs a procedure set; a tank terminal or midstream company tightening oversight of its contractors; an operator's quality group auditing NDT vendors; or a company whose Level III has just left. Atlantis is based in Houston and handles this work as ASNT NDT Level III consulting, with program documents prepared remotely and site visits around the metro when an examination, demonstration or audit needs one.

What do Houston companies hire an NDT consultant to do?

  • Vendor prequalification packages. Operators and EPC contractors in the corridor ask for the written practice, a current procedure index, certification files and calibration records before a contractor can bid. Gaps here lose contracts, not just audit points.
  • Code-job procedure sets for fabricators. Shops building pressure vessels, skids and piping spools need UT, MT, PT and VT procedures written against the ASME Section V edition and construction code named on the job, plus a demonstration where the code or the purchaser asks for one.
  • Terminal and tank programs. Storage terminals in Pasadena, Baytown and along the channel need procedures and personnel records that match the inspection plan their API 653 inspector works to.
  • Audits of NDT subcontractors. Owners bring in an outside Level III to audit a contractor's program against its own written practice and the owner's specification, then follow up the findings.
  • Bridging documents for joint ventures and EPC projects where two companies' written practices and procedures must be reconciled for one job.

Texas rules that shape a Houston NDT program

Boilers and pressure vessels in Texas come under the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation's Boiler Program, so NDE on repairs and alterations ends up in records its inspectors and the repair organization keep. Industrial radiographers in Texas must hold certification from the Department of State Health Services under 25 TAC §289.255. When a code calls for radiography, the owner's licensed radiography contractor supplies those people; Atlantis does not perform radiography in the US. Federal process safety rules and each operator's own NDT specification then set most of the day-to-day requirements a contractor is measured against.

How Houston's NDT consulting options differ

  • Training schools with consulting arms. NDTCS, a Houston NDT school, offers written practices, procedure writing, Level III retainers and second- and third-party audits, and TXNDT, another Texas NDT school, advertises a similar menu that includes expert-witness support. A school suits a company that also wants in-person training nearby.
  • Inspection companies. Mistras says its Level IIIs can be formally appointed to represent a client and offers written practice development, procedure writing and approval of radiographic images; IRISNDT runs Houston, Deer Park and Texas City locations that lead with inspection. Convenient when you already buy inspection from them.
  • In-house Level IIIs at the larger operators and contractors, who know the site but are stretched across methods and audits.
  • Remote outsourced Level III support, where documents and reviews are done at a distance and visits are booked for examinations and audits.

Checklist before you hire an NDT consultant in Houston

  • Which methods does the named Level III actually hold? Compare the certificate with every method your technicians perform.
  • Has the consultant written a practice that passed an operator audit in this corridor, and can they show a redacted copy?
  • Will one person sign everything, or is the work spread across people whose credentials you have not seen?
  • If the consultant's company also sells you inspection, who audits that company's reports? Put the answer in the contract.
  • How are revisions controlled after hand-over, so nobody works from an old procedure at the next turnaround?

How Atlantis works with Houston clients

The work is led by Anoop Rayavarapu, who holds ASNT NDT Level III certification in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT. Because Atlantis is based in Houston, procedure demonstrations, practical examinations and audits around the Ship Channel can be arranged as short visits, while drafting and review run remotely. If what you need is specifically a Level III of record for your company, read ASNT Level III consulting in Houston. For broader program work, start with NDT audit consulting, procedure development, procedure qualification and demonstration or bridging documents; fabricators can compare written practices for fabrication shops. If you need the inspection itself, NDT inspection services in Houston covers UT, MT, PT and VT. Send the scope through the Houston consulting request; we reply within one business day.
